metadata.title: Lioneer — Technology for a Greener Planet
metadata.description: Lioneer builds software that helps people understand and protect the environment. Explore our projects in air quality monitoring, waste classification, and climate insights.

hero.title: Technology for a greener planet
hero.subtitle: We build open-source software that monitors air quality, classifies waste, and visualizes climate data — empowering communities to understand and protect their environment.

projects.sectionSubtitle: Tools and platforms we're building to help people understand the environment around them.

airQuality.title: Air Quality & Gas Classification
airQuality.description: Monitors and classifies atmospheric gases including CO₂, CH₄, N₂O, CO, NO₂, SO₂, O₃, and CFCs by source and harm level — distinguishing greenhouse gases from toxic pollutants.

wasteClassification.title: Smart Waste Classification
wasteClassification.description: An AI-powered image classifier that sorts trash into Recycling, Plastic (PET, HDPE, PP), Organic, Paper, Glass, Metal, Hazardous, and General waste — with bin color suggestions and disposal tips.

climateInsights.title: Climate Change Insights
climateInsights.description: Visualizes temperature trends, sea-level rise, and carbon emissions with interactive charts and simple, accessible explanations for everyone.

carbonFootprint.title: Carbon Footprint Calculator
carbonFootprint.description: Calculate your personal or organizational carbon footprint with our comprehensive tool. Get actionable recommendations to reduce your environmental impact.

waterQuality.title: Water Quality Monitor
waterQuality.description: Real-time monitoring of water quality parameters including pH, dissolved oxygen, turbidity, and contaminant levels across rivers, lakes, and coastal areas.

spotlight.sectionSubtitle: See how our classification systems work with real examples.

co2.name: CO₂ — Carbon Dioxide
co2.source: Fossil fuel combustion, deforestation, industrial processes
co2.impact: Primary driver of global warming. Traps heat in the atmosphere, causing rising temperatures and ocean acidification.

ch4.name: CH₄ — Methane
ch4.source: Livestock, rice paddies, landfills, natural gas systems
ch4.impact: 80× more potent than CO₂ over 20 years. Major contributor to near-term climate change.

no2.name: NO₂ — Nitrogen Dioxide
no2.source: Vehicle exhaust, power plants, industrial emissions
no2.impact: Irritates airways, worsens asthma, contributes to smog and acid rain. Harms lung development in children.

so2.name: SO₂ — Sulfur Dioxide
so2.source: Coal and oil burning, smelting, volcanic activity
so2.impact: Causes acid rain, respiratory illness, and visibility reduction. Damages ecosystems and corrodes buildings.

o3.name: O₃ — Ozone (Ground-Level)
o3.source: Formed by sunlight reacting with vehicle/industrial emissions
o3.impact: Triggers breathing problems, aggravates asthma, and damages crops. Good in stratosphere, harmful at ground level.

plasticBottle.name: Plastic Bottle (PET)
plasticBottle.tip: Rinse, remove cap, and crush before placing in recycling bin. PET is widely recyclable.

banana.name: Banana Peel
banana.tip: Place in compost or green organic waste bin. Excellent for home composting.

battery.name: AA Battery
battery.tip: Never throw in general waste. Take to a hazardous waste collection point or battery recycling drop-off.

newspaper.name: Newspaper
newspaper.tip: Keep dry and clean. Bundle or place flat in paper recycling bin. Avoid if contaminated with food.

glassJar.name: Glass Jar
glassJar.tip: Rinse clean, remove metal lids. Glass is infinitely recyclable without quality loss.

howItWorks.sectionSubtitle: From data collection to real-world impact, our process is simple and effective.
howItWorks.step1Description: Sensors, satellite imagery, and community reports gather environmental data from around the world.
howItWorks.step2Description: Machine learning models classify, predict, and visualize environmental patterns in real time.
howItWorks.step3Description: Insights are delivered through dashboards, alerts, and recommendations so communities can act fast.

about.sectionSubtitle: Our mission and what drives us forward.
about.mission: We believe technology can be a force for environmental good. Lioneer was founded to bridge the gap between complex environmental data and everyday understanding.
about.vision: Our vision is a world where everyone has access to clear, actionable environmental information — from the air they breathe to the waste they produce.

sustainability.title: Sustainability
sustainability.description: Every decision we make is guided by its environmental impact. We build tools that encourage sustainable practices.

openData.title: Open Data
openData.description: Environmental data belongs to everyone. We commit to open-source code and publicly accessible datasets.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: We push the boundaries of what's possible with AI, IoT, and data visualization to solve environmental challenges.

impact.title: Join us in building a cleaner future
impact.subtitle: Whether you're a developer, researcher, educator, or concerned citizen — there's a place for you in the Lioneer community.
